ownership_rule: Every table, index, trigger/check-support object and projection-storage object declared by the four LLD-06 schema_sources is allocated to migration sequence 7 unless the schema leaf explicitly identifies it as an earlier-packet foreign identity reference. Implementation must generate the exact STRICT/FK/index closure from those normative leaves; it may not omit or rename an owned object ad hoc.
foreign_identity_rules: Customer Organization identities reference LLD-02 earlier sequence authority.
Service Request identity/current Customer and accepted source evidence reference LLD-03/04 earlier authority through their declared FK/provider boundaries.

LLD-06 creates no physical dependency on later Objective/Inventory/Infrastructure/Communications tables; report contributor rows store versioned normalized evidence owned by the report snapshot rather than cross-packet live FKs that would create migration cycles.
strict_policy: All LLD-06 owned relational tables are SQLite STRICT with explicit CHECK constraints; every non-PK FK and every leading predicate used by classification, policy, cohort, report-sealing or cleanup guards receives supporting index coverage.
runtime_contract: LLD-01 AcceptedMigrationRunner freezes exact implementation SQL bytes/hash under the global sequence-7 allocation only after implementation review. This design manifest is object allocation authority, not accepted runtime SQL.
